recordedRevenue.definition: Saved fares from completed rides plus saved cancellation fees; missing cancellation fees contribute zero.
recordedRevenue.formula: sum(eligible completed ride fares) + sum(saved cancellation fees)

fuelSpending.definition: Sum of recorded refill amounts in the selected period, including partial refills.

fuelCostPerKm.definition: Fuel cost per kilometre from consecutive valid full-tank odometer readings only; partial fills do not create intervals.
fuelCostPerKm.formula: recorded cost for qualified full-tank interval / interval kilometres

incomeAfterFuel.definition: Recorded revenue less recorded fuel spending. Revenue includes cancellation fees.

excluded.rule: No forecasts, targets, break-even models, provisions, profitability models, loan amortization, prepayment estimates, maintenance projections, compliance provisions, recovery balances, or unrelated financial calculations.
